summary: Tastees Manufacturing is a family-run snack maker in St. Venera, Malta, whose Maralicious brand includes potato chips; it also makes rice-based, corn-based and plant-based snacks. Its factory dates from 1969, and the company took its present name in 2019. It is linked to Strand Palace Agencies, the Calleja family's distribution company.
founded: 1969 (factory, as Darrell Lea Foods Ltd; renamed Tastees Manufacturing Ltd in 2019)
products: Maralicious potato chips: Fancy Round Crinckled
Topsy plant-based snacks and Veggie Sticks
